title: Add PipeWire registry capture and recovery integration tests
description:
Create integration tests that exercise real PipeWire registry enumeration and capture-engine recovery paths. These tests require a running PipeWire daemon and must clean up every temporary stream, link, and node they create.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/pipewire/PipeWireContext.hpp and src/pipewire/PipeWireContext.cpp for the registry event-driven listener and GlobalObject lifecycle.
- src/audio/CaptureSession.hpp and src/audio/CaptureSession.cpp for session states, reconnection logic, and source-loss handling.
- src/audio/AudioRingBuffer.hpp for the buffer interface the capture engine writes into.
- CMakeLists.txt for the existing integration test target and PipeWire link flags.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

test_pipewire_registry.cpp: Connect to the running PipeWire daemon, enumerate available nodes, verify at least one audio sink or source is reported, confirm node property access (name, media class, format), disconnect cleanly. Include a test that registers a change callback, verifies it fires on a synthetic node addition if possible, and deregisters without leaking the callback.

test_capture_recovery.cpp: Start a short capture session against a null or test sink, verify audio frames arrive in the ring buffer, simulate stream-lost by disconnecting the stream, verify the engine reports the error state and attempts recovery within a bounded timeout, stop and clean up. Include a stress path that starts and stops capture 10 times in rapid succession and asserts no resource leaks (file descriptors, PipeWire proxy objects). All tests must have a hard timeout guard (no longer than 30 seconds per test case) to prevent CI hangs.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/test_pipewire_registry.cpp exists and compiles as part of the integration test target
tests/integration/test_capture_recovery.cpp exists and compiles as part of the integration test target
Registry test connects to PipeWire, enumerates nodes, and disconnects without leaking resources
Recovery test exercises stream-lost error path and verifies bounded recovery attempt
Stress test starts/stops capture at least 10 times and asserts no resource leak
Every test case has a hard timeout guard of 30 seconds or less
All temporary PipeWire streams, links, and proxies are cleaned up in test teardown
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: choose test fixture names and setup/teardown structure
choose timeout values within the 30-second per-test ceiling
use null sink or test sink for capture tests
choose stress iteration count at or above 10
forbidden: leave streams or proxies uncleaned in any test path
add tests that require specific hardware audio devices
